passages.text: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.” He was afraid, and said, “How dreadful is this place! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”
passages.note: Waking to the sacred in an ordinary place

passages.text: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.
passages.note: Love makes long waiting and work feel short
